subject: Adjustment Request: Half-Month Add-on Allocation & VAT ID Sync for Clearline
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearlinecorp.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: payments@clearlinecorp.com
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: half-month add-on allocation & VAT ID update

Hi Diego,

Quick one — we added the "RealTime-Streaming" add-on (3 seats) on July 16th after our monthly invoice had already issued on July 1st. Our AP team is asking for a short, prorated line so they can reconcile this month; they also want the invoice to show our updated VAT ID (CL-VAT-99832) for EU reporting.

Can Redwood issue an interim invoice line or a credit + replacement invoice showing:
- prorated charge for 15 days (Jul 16–31) at the add-on rate
- VAT ID populated on the invoice
- a small note that this is a mid-cycle allocation and not a contract amendment

I attached the invoice they received (CL-INV-8821.pdf) and the purchase confirmation. We can pay the balance once the AP team has a clear, line-item-friendly invoice.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Finance Manager, Clearline Corp
alicia.gomez@clearlinecorp.com
+1 415-555-0199

Attachments: CL-INV-8821.pdf (invoice), purchase-confirmation.pdf

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearlinecorp.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: half-month add-on allocation & VAT ID update

Hi Alicia — thank you for the clear summary and the invoice. Looping in Monica from Billing and Sean on collections to coordinate the legal VAT field and the prorated math.

Short plan: Monica will confirm the prorated line and whether we issue a standalone interim invoice or a credit + replacement invoice. Sean will confirm the payment path and whether Clearline can apply payment against the original invoice once the replacement is posted.

Monica / Sean — context: Clearline added 3 seats to the RealTime-Streaming add-on on 2026-07-16. They need a 15-day proration line and the updated VAT ID (CL-VAT-99832) populated on any billing document we issue. They prefer a single replacement invoice if feasible.

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearlinecorp.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: half-month add-on allocation & VAT ID update

Hi Diego / Alicia — I ran the numbers and sketched two options; attaching the calculation workbook (proration-calculation-CL-8821.xlsx). Summary below.

Option A — Replacement invoice (preferred for AP clarity):
- Void original invoice CL-INV-8821 and issue CL-INV-8821-R1 with:
  * Original subscription lines unchanged
  * New line: RealTime-Streaming add-on (3 seats) — prorated Jul 16–31 (15/30 days)
  * VAT ID populated: CL-VAT-99832
  * Net effect: replacement invoice shows only the prorated charge for the add-on and maintains the same invoice number with -R1 suffix.
- Rationale: single document for AP, no separate credit to track.

Option B — Credit + interim invoice:
- Issue a credit memo for CL-INV-8821 in the amount of the prorated add-on, then a small interim invoice for the add-on with VAT ID set.
- Rationale: preserves original invoice but requires AP to apply credit then process new invoice.

Calculation (Option A numbers):
- Monthly add-on seat rate: $200 / seat / month
- Seats added: 3
- Daily rate (30d month): $200 / 30 = $6.6667
- Days charged: 15
- Prorated charge = 3 * $6.6667 * 15 = $300.00 (net)
- VAT (if applicable at 20% for EU reporting): $60.00
- Gross prorated line: $360.00

We can post CL-INV-8821-R1 within 24 business hours after Alicia confirms preferred option. If you prefer Option B, we'll issue a credit memo and an interim invoice the same day.

Alicia — quick question: is the VAT liability on your end (reverse charge) or should we collect VAT on the interim? If Clearline expects reverse-charge, we will mark the line accordingly and leave VAT at 0 but show the VAT ID. If you want Redwood to collect VAT, we will add the 20% line as above.

Attaching: proration-calculation-CL-8821.xlsx (breakdown), draft replacement invoice template (not a PDF yet).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearlinecorp.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: payments@clearlinecorp.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 12:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: half-month add-on allocation & VAT ID update

Thanks Monica — Option A (replacement invoice) works best for our AP flow. For VAT: Clearline will self-assess via reverse charge, so please leave VAT at 0% but include CL-VAT-99832 in the invoice's VAT ID field and add the text: "Reverse charge — customer liable for VAT per EU Directive".

We'd like the replacement invoice to include a short note: "Mid-cycle allocation for add-on seats (Jul 16–31). Not a contract amendment."

We confirm payment will be processed against the replacement invoice once issued. Please send the PDF to payments@clearlinecorp.com and cc me.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alicia

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearlinecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: half-month add-on allocation & VAT ID update

All — confirmed on the collections side. Once Monica issues CL-INV-8821-R1 with the reverse-charge note and VAT ID, payments@clearlinecorp.com can remit via the usual bank transfer. We'll accept payment against the replacement invoice; no hold required.

I'll monitor for receipt and release the applied payment to Clearline's account immediately. Monica — please flag the invoice in our AR system so it replaces CL-INV-8821.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Manager, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
